meanings.note: Pinyin: mù chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木窗 ('a wooden window').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 推开二楼的木窗就能闻到桂花香。
examples.trans: Push open the second-floor wooden window and smell sweet osmanthus.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇木门 ('a wooden door').

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

本.gloss: measure word for books and notebooks

meanings.en: measure word for books and notebooks
meanings.note: Pinyin: běn. Counts bound volumes, notebooks, ledgers, and albums (一本书, 一本账本).

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 书桌上放着两本旧乐谱。
examples.trans: Two old music books sit on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn zi. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本本子 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: běn lái. Indicates what was originally planned or true.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo lì. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部条例 ('a municipal regulation').

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

examples.text: 根据城市历史街区条例，老砖墙必须保留。
examples.trans: Under the historic district regulation, the old brick wall must stay.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo wén. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条条文 ('a legal clause').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 律师把合同里的每一条条文都读了一遍。
examples.trans: The lawyer read through every single clause in the contract.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.en: not have enough time; be too late
meanings.note: Pinyin: lái bu jí. Opposite of 来得及 ('make it in time').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 再不出发就来不及赶八点的火车了！
examples.trans: If we do not head out now, we will never make the eight o'clock train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封来信 ('a letter received').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 啊！忙着行李箱、热水器和来信，我完全忘了！
examples.trans: Oh! With the suitcases, the water heater, and the letter, I completely forgot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái huí. Describes pacing back and forth or a round trip.

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

examples.text: 从客栈到五金店走一个来回只要十分钟。
examples.trans: A round trip on foot from the inn to the hardware shop takes ten minutes.

杯.gloss: measure word for cups and glasses

meanings.en: measure word for cups and glasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi. Counts cups of tea, coffee, water, or juice (一杯热茶 'a cup of hot tea').

examples.text: 太客气了，周经理。半杯就好。
examples.trans: How polite of you, Manager Zhou. Half a glass is fine.

examples.text: 坐下吧，小晴！早上你跑了半条街，喝杯咖啡。
examples.trans: Sit down, Qing! You ran half the street this morning—drink a cup of coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bēi zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个杯子 ('a cup').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 请往我的杯子里再加一点热水。
examples.trans: Please add a little more hot water to my cup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sōng. Describes a loose screw/handle or relaxing tension (松一口气 'breathe a sigh of relief').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěn tou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个枕头 ('a pillow').

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǒ jiàng. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶果酱 ('a jar of jam').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

related.gloss: a jar of jam (measure word 瓶)

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个架子 ('a shelf').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: róu huà. Describes wooden beams or curtains softening echoes.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 厚实的棉窗帘柔化了早晨刺眼的阳光。
examples.trans: Thick cotton curtains softened the bright morning sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜台 ('a counter').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柜子 ('a cabinet').

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

examples.text: 我去柜子拿干净的白床单！
examples.trans: I will fetch clean white bedsheets from the cupboard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng méng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个柠檬 ('a lemon').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

栋.gloss: measure word for buildings and houses

meanings.en: measure word for buildings and houses
meanings.note: Pinyin: dòng. Counts whole standalone buildings (一栋老房子 'an old building').

examples.text: 二十五年前？就在同一栋房子里？
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? Right inside that very same house?

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù xià. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 树下阴凉 ('shade under the tree').

examples.text: 我把蓝色行李箱放在树下志豪桌子边了。
examples.trans: I placed the blue suitcase right beside Hao's table under the tree.

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

related.gloss: shade under the tree (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù yè. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片树叶 ('a leaf').

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 风一吹，绿树叶沙沙地响。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the green leaves rustle softly.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美正从他们那桌走回来呢。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is walking back from their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块桌布 ('a tablecloth').

examples.text: 给，干净白桌布和两只蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Here—a clean white tablecloth and two blue teacups.

examples.text: 每张餐桌上都换上了干净的白桌布。
examples.trans: Every dining table was dressed in a crisp white tablecloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáo. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座桥 ('a bridge').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Counts weighty matters or pieces of business (一桩事 'a matter').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 这可是一桩让人高兴的好事。
examples.trans: This really is a happy piece of news.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mèng xiǎng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个梦想 ('a dream').

examples.text: 我梦想中的咖啡馆——就在自家院子里！等我去告诉市场老板们！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the market stall owners!

examples.text: 开一家温暖的院子咖啡馆一直是她的梦想。
examples.trans: Opening a cozy courtyard café has always been her dream.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn chá. Used for checking pipes, tags, or rooms.

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

examples.text: 谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
examples.trans: Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàng. Warm colloquial adjective for praising food, work, or ideas (太棒了！).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zōng sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种棕色 ('a shade of brown').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

related.gloss: a shade of brown (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ zi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把椅子 ('a chair').

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋楼 ('a building').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu shàng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼上房间 ('an upstairs floor').

examples.text: 老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Chen! Is the shower water upstairs really cold already?

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu xià. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼下大堂 ('the floor downstairs').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu tī. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座楼梯 ('a staircase').

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等等——三楼楼梯上面是什么地方？
examples.trans: Wait—what is above the stairs on the third floor?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng zhī. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯橙汁 ('a glass of orange juice').

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

related.gloss: a glass of orange juice (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng mù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块橡木 ('a piece of oak').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 这张大书桌是用结实的橡木做的。
examples.trans: This big desk is crafted from solid oak.

related.gloss: a piece of oak (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cì. Standard verbal measure word counting how many times an action happens (一次 'once', 下次 'next time').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个歉意 ('an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 昨天是我不对，向你道个歉。
examples.trans: Yesterday was my fault; let me offer you an apology.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng zài. Placed before a verb to mark an action happening at this very moment.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

meanings.en: just right; happen to; right on the dot
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng hǎo. Marks a lucky coincidence or exact fit.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng cháng. Describes normal water pressure or normal operation.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 修好阀门以后，三楼水压完全正常了。
examples.trans: After fixing the valve, third-floor water pressure is completely normal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng shì. Describes formal speech or a permanent job after probation.

examples.text: 我一紧张，句子就变得又长又正式！
examples.trans: Whenever I get nervous, my sentences turn long and formal!

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng què. Praises an exact answer.

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 您填写的电话号码和地址完全正确。
examples.trans: The phone number and address you wrote down are completely correct.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Counts footsteps or stages (一步 'one step').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Forms comparisons in A 比 B + adj ('A is more adj than B').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ lì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个比例 ('a proportion').

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

examples.text: 做面包的时候，面粉和水的比例很重要。
examples.trans: When baking bread, the ratio of flour to water matters a lot.

meanings.en: compare side by side; match against
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ duì. Used for matching a spare part or handwriting sample.

examples.text: 他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
examples.trans: He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!

examples.text: 前台仔细比对了两个蓝色行李箱上的名字。
examples.trans: Reception carefully compared the names on both blue suitcases.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jiào. Before an adjective, means 'fairly/rather'.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 二楼靠院子的房间晚上比较安静。
examples.trans: Second-floor rooms facing the courtyard are fairly quiet at night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo jīn. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条毛巾 ('a towel').

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo yī. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件毛衣 ('a sweater').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 妈妈织的灰色羊毛毛衣特别暖和。
examples.trans: The gray wool sweater Mother knitted is wonderfully warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: háo mǐ. Metric unit taking numbers directly without 个.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
examples.trans: Make sure the brass ring inside is twenty millimetres wide.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì. Measure word (量词): 口 (kǒu), e.g. 一口气 ('a breath').

examples.text: 太松一口气了！志豪先生，给您银钥匙。
examples.trans: What a relief! Mr Zhihao, here is your silver key.

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì pào shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 瓶 (píng), e.g. 一瓶气泡水 ('a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 加一片新鲜柠檬在冰气泡水里特别清爽。
examples.trans: A slice of fresh lemon in chilled sparkling water is super refreshing.

related.gloss: a bottle of sparkling water (measure word 瓶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí guǎn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根水管 ('a water pipe').

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ fá. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个水阀 ('a water valve').

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

examples.text: 修水管以前，记得先把总水阀关掉。
examples.trans: Before fixing a water pipe, remember to shut off the main water valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ lóng tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个水龙头 ('a water tap').

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
examples.trans: Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiú. Used for earnest requests (求你了 'please, I beg you!').

examples.text: 老陈，求你告诉我只是水管进了一点气！
examples.trans: Chen, please tell me it was just a tiny bit of air in the pipe!

examples.text: 我求他再给我们一天时间。
examples.trans: I pleaded with him to give us one more day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng. Measure word (量词): 碗 (wǎn), e.g. 一碗汤 ('a bowl of soup').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

related.gloss: a bowl of soup (measure word 碗)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tāng wǎn. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只汤碗 ('a soup bowl').

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

examples.text: 热蔬菜汤装在白瓷汤碗里端上来了。
examples.trans: Hot vegetable soup came out in a white porcelain soup bowl.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qì chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆汽车 ('a car').

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
examples.trans: No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi guān xi. Warm reply to 对不起 ('no problem at all').

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

examples.text: 不小心洒了一点水没关系，我拿布擦一下就好。
examples.trans: Spilling a drop of water is no problem—I will wipe it right up.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.en: have no free time; be tied up
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi kòng. Note fourth tone kòng ('free time').

examples.text: 老陈，两个铜阀门给你！喘口气？没空！
examples.trans: Chen, here are both brass valves! Catch my breath? No time!

examples.text: 早上客人太多，我忙得连喝水都没空。
examples.trans: There were so many morning guests that I had no time even for a sip of water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi cuò. Enthusiastic agreement ('Spot on! / Exactly!').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条河 ('a river').

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 小石桥下面是一条安静的河。
examples.trans: Beneath the small stone bridge runs a quiet river.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片河水 ('river water').

examples.text: 跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
examples.trans: Cold as river water. Put this broken brass valve into your coat pocket.

examples.text: 春天到了，桥下的河水清澈又安静。
examples.trans: Spring is here, and the river water beneath the bridge runs clear and calm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yóu qī. Measure word (量词): 桶, e.g. 一桶油漆 ('a bucket of paint').

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 木门上的蓝油漆还是去年新刷的。
examples.trans: The blue paint on the wooden door was freshly brushed on last year.

related.gloss: a bucket of paint (measure word 桶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎ. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部法律 ('a law').

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 我们要遵守老城区的保护法。
examples.trans: We follow the Old Quarter preservation act.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fǎ lǜ. Measure word (量词): 部, e.g. 一部法律 ('a law').

examples.text: 法律条文我戴两副眼镜看都头疼！
examples.trans: Legal clauses give me a headache even with two pairs of glasses!

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for liquids spilling out of a cup or pot.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 小心端稳，别把热茶洒出来。
examples.trans: Carry it steadily so you do not spill the hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí shǒu chí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个洗手池 ('a bathroom sink').

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 洗手池上面的小镜子擦得一尘不染。
examples.trans: The mirror above the bathroom washbasin is wiped spotless.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí shǒu jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间洗手间 ('a bathroom').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí zǎo. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
examples.trans: Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?

examples.text: 跑了一身汗，洗个热水澡最舒服了。
examples.trans: After working up a sweat, a hot shower feels best of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xí záo shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 缸, e.g. 一缸洗澡水 ('hot bathwater').

examples.text: 明天早上七点，洗澡水会冰凉。
examples.trans: At seven tomorrow morning, the shower water will be ice-cold.

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huó. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件活儿 ('a piece of work').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 手里的活做完就可以休息了。
examples.trans: Once we finish the work in hand, we can rest.

related.gloss: a piece of work (measure word 件)

meanings.note: Pinyin: cè liáng. Used for measuring dimensions or sound levels.

examples.text: 满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Who measures lobbies unless...

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎi yán. Measure word (量词): 撮, e.g. 一撮海盐 ('a pinch of sea salt').

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a pinch of sea salt (measure word 撮)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāo xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好消息 ('a piece of good news').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

related.gloss: a piece of good news (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn. Describes faint memories, light tea, or lightly salted food.

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 这壶绿茶味道很清淡。
examples.trans: This pot of green tea has a light, clean taste.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Used for refilling tea or politely apologizing for causing extra trouble (添麻烦).

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 真不好意思，又给您添麻烦了。
examples.trans: So sorry to have caused you extra trouble again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng chu. Describes clear speech, clear handwriting, or hearing clearly (听得很清楚).

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

examples.text: 这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
examples.trans: I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng kōng. Result compound meaning 'clear out everything inside'.

examples.text: 搬家公司清空梧桐巷之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared Wutong Lane, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 搬家以前，我们把储藏室全部清空了。
examples.trans: Before moving, we emptied out the entire storage room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn. Describes lukewarm water or mild temperatures.

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 壶里的水还是温的，正好喝。
examples.trans: The water in the pot is still warm—just right to drink.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn xīn. Favorite praise for a homey inn or café.

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 暖黄色的台灯让整间客房显得格外温馨。
examples.trans: Warm yellow lamps make the whole guest room feel extra cozy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shī. Describes clothes, shoes, or streets wet from rain.

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá. Describes wet stone steps being slippery or an object sliding down.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn fēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个满分 ('a perfect score').

examples.text: 满分十分给了九分？！谁会测量大堂，除非……
examples.trans: Nine out of ten?! Who measures lobbies unless...

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn yì. Describes happy guests or hosts.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 客人们对今天的现烤早餐非常满意。
examples.trans: The guests were very pleased with today's freshly baked breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Used as a verb ('drip') or measure word for drops of liquid.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: piào liang. Praises attractive rooms or a job done with flair.

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 这盘金黄色的柠檬蛋糕做得真漂亮！
examples.trans: This plate of golden lemon cake turned out beautifully!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lòu. Used for leaking pipes or roofs (漏水) and omitted items.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
examples.trans: Not a single drop leaking! Can we light the water heater now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lòu shuǐ. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 小美，里面出什么事了？热水管又漏水了吗？
examples.trans: Mei, is something wrong inside? Did the hot-water pipe leak again?

examples.text: 老陈检查了一遍，厨房水槽没有漏水。
examples.trans: Chen checked everything over, and the kitchen sink is not leaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jiáng gǎo. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份演讲稿 ('a speech draft').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 他在安静的书桌前修改明天的演讲稿。
examples.trans: At the quiet desk he revised tomorrow's lecture notes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团火 ('a fire').

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 炉子上的小火还开着。
examples.trans: The low flame on the stove is still on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ miáo. Measure word (量词): 朵, e.g. 一朵火苗 ('a small flame').

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 热水器里蓝色的火苗烧得很稳。
examples.trans: The blue flame inside the water heater is burning steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē. Measure word (量词): 列 (liè), e.g. 一列火车 ('a train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个火车头 ('a toy/train locomotive').

examples.text: 拆开白纸……不会吧！爷爷亲手雕的木头火车头！
examples.trans: Unwrap the white paper... no way! Grandfather's hand-carved wooden locomotive!

examples.text: 木头小火车头的轮子还能灵活转动。
examples.trans: The wheels on the little wooden locomotive still spin smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǒ chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个火车站 ('a train station').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯 ('a lamp').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng guāng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片灯光 ('warm lamplight').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng pào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个灯泡 ('a light bulb').

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 走廊里的灯泡坏了，我马上去换个新的。
examples.trans: The hallway light bulb went out; I will replace it right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午擦亮挂着的纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you polishing the hanging paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī chén. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层灰尘 ('a layer of dust').

examples.text: 把上面铜牌的灰尘擦掉……等等，快念那个数字！
examples.trans: Brush the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

examples.text: 他用干布擦掉了木盒上面的灰尘。
examples.trans: He wiped the dust off the wooden box with a dry cloth.

related.gloss: a layer of dust (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī xīn. Literally 'ash-hearted' (别灰心 'don't lose heart').

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 一次没烤好没关系，千万别灰心。
examples.trans: If one batch does not bake right, never mind—do not lose heart.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种灰色 ('a shade of gray').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

related.gloss: a shade of gray (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎo dàn. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘炒蛋 ('a plate of scrambled eggs').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
examples.trans: Qing bought sea-salt butter, so today we are making soft scrambled eggs!

related.gloss: a plate of scrambled eggs (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn tóu. Separable verb-object compound showing agreement.

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

examples.text: 听了小晴的建议，大家都笑着点头。
examples.trans: Hearing Qing's suggestion, everyone smiled and nodded.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fán xīn shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件烦心事 ('a worrying matter').

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么好意思拿房东烦心事打扰付钱的客人！
examples.trans: Oh dear, how could we bother a paying guest with our landlord troubles!

examples.text: 喝杯热甜茶，把今天的烦心事都放下吧。
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot sweet tea and set aside today's worries.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàng. Describes piping-hot tea/soup or ironing clothes neat (烫好).

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 汤刚出锅，小心很烫。
examples.trans: The soup just came off the stove—careful, it is piping hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè hū hū. Cozy ABB-pattern adjective for warm pastries or soup.

examples.text: 早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.

examples.text: 早上吃一个热乎乎的肉桂卷真幸福。
examples.trans: Eating a piping-warm cinnamon roll in the morning is pure bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶热水 ('a pot of hot water').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

related.gloss: a pot of hot water (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuǐ qì. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台热水器 ('a water heater').

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shuí guǎn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根热水管 ('a hot-water pipe').

examples.text: 听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
examples.trans: I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.

examples.text: 小美，里面出什么事了？热水管又漏水了吗？
examples.trans: Mei, is something wrong inside? Did the hot-water pipe leak again?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè shēn. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 正式弹曲子以前，她先弹音阶热身。
examples.trans: Before playing the piece, she warmed up with scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè nao. Positive praise for cheerful, bustling streets or gatherings.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

examples.text: 早上八点一过，整条老街就热闹起来了。
examples.trans: Right past eight in the morning, the whole historic street comes alive.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rán hòu. Connects sequential events across clauses.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

examples.text: 先把门把手往上提，然后再往里推。
examples.trans: Lift the door handle upward first, and then push inward.

meanings.en: shine; follow/according to; take a photo
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào. Means sunlight shining in, or acting according to a plan (照着).

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 早上的阳光照进安静的书房。
examples.trans: Morning sunlight shines into the quiet study.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhào gu. Used for tending guests, plants, or family.

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 这几天多亏你们细心照顾。
examples.trans: Thank you so much for looking after me so thoughtfully these past few days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pá. Used for climbing stairs, hills, or ladders.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ài. Expresses love for people, places, or favorite habits.

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 街坊们都爱来院子里喝早茶。
examples.trans: The neighbors all love coming to the courtyard for morning tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yé ye. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位爷爷 ('a grandfather').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 我只写了：星期五中午，爷爷留的东西在小院客栈等你。
examples.trans: I only wrote: Friday at noon, something left by Grandfather is waiting for you at Courtyard Inn.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuáng lǎng. Describes warm, ringing laughter.

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

examples.text: 院子里传来老陈爽朗的笑声。
examples.trans: Chen's hearty laughter rang across the courtyard.

片.gloss: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets

meanings.en: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets
meanings.note: Pinyin: piàn. Counts thin, flat slices of bread, lemon, cheese, or leaves (一片面包 'a slice of bread').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 他在红茶里放了一片新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: He put a slice of fresh lemon into his black tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: niú nǎi. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯牛奶 ('a glass of milk').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

related.gloss: a glass of milk (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tè bié. Very common intensifier before adjectives/verbs ('especially'), or adjective ('special').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 都没有！他特别喜欢安静的木房梁，还谢谢我们呢。
examples.trans: Neither! He loved the quiet wooden beams and even thanked us.

meanings.en: specially; purposely; out of one's way
meanings.note: Pinyin: tè yì. Highlights thoughtful effort done specifically for someone.

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cāi cai. Playful reduplication of 猜 ('guess').

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 你猜猜今天早上谁来我们咖啡馆了？
examples.trans: Guess who stopped by our café this morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn dài. Describes modern buildings or appliances.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 老房子外观古朴，里面的浴室却很现代。
examples.trans: The old house looks classic outside, yet its bathrooms are modern.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn jīn. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔现金 ('a sum of cash').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
examples.trans: Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!

related.gloss: a sum of cash (measure word 笔)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn guì. Describes keepsakes, memories, or historic craft.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Counts scheduled trains/flights (同一班火车 'the same train') and work shifts (上班).

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，您拿错了她的箱子？
examples.trans: Wait—you rode the same train on Monday, and you took her suitcase by mistake?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ yóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个理由 ('a reason').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 她从小就喜欢每天练琴。
examples.trans: She has loved practicing the piano every day since childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Counts bottles of water, milk, or jam (一瓶气泡水 'a bottle of sparkling water').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 冰箱里还有两瓶冰牛奶。
examples.trans: There are still two bottles of cold milk in the fridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng qì. Literally 'generate air/steam'—separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 因为怕你还在生气。这三年我很想你。
examples.trans: Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you very much these three years.

examples.text: 只是一场小误会，别再生气啦。
examples.trans: It was only a small mix-up—do not stay mad anymore.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng huó. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种生活 ('a way of life').

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.text: 大家都喜欢成都这种慢节奏的生活。
examples.trans: Everyone loves this unhurried pace of life in Chengdu.

related.gloss: a way of life (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng lì. Literally 'use force'.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 这把旧锁有点紧，往右转的时候要用力。
examples.trans: This old lock is stiff; turn firmly to the right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn xiàn. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根电线 ('an electric wire').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn nǎo. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台电脑 ('a computer').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 我在前台电脑上查到了您的预订记录。
examples.trans: I found your reservation on the front-desk computer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个电话 ('a phone call').

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个男人 ('a man').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 穿深灰西装的那个男人是位建筑师。
examples.trans: That man in the dark gray suit is an architect.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nán xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双男鞋 ('a pair of men's shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 鞋架下面放着两双棕色的男鞋。
examples.trans: Two pairs of brown men's shoes sit on the bottom of the rack.

related.gloss: a pair of men's shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Requires a digit before it in Mandarin (一百 'one hundred', never bare 百 for 100).

examples.text: 留下来跟大家在一起？愿意——一百个愿意！
examples.trans: Stay here together with all of you? Yes—a hundred times yes!

examples.text: 这棵老树已经有一百多年了。
examples.trans: This old tree is already more than a hundred years old.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi yè chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇百叶窗 ('a louvered shutter').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 午后把木百叶窗放下一半，屋里既凉快又柔和。
examples.trans: Lowering the wooden shutters halfway at noon keeps the room cool and soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张皮 ('a piece of leather').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

related.gloss: a piece of leather (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí xié. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双皮鞋 ('a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 下雨天出门，最好别穿新皮鞋。
examples.trans: Heading out in the rain, it is best not to wear new leather shoes.

related.gloss: a pair of leather shoes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhòu. Pairs with 眉头 in 皱眉头 ('furrow one's brow / frown').

examples.text: 他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

盏.gloss: measure word for lamps and lanterns

meanings.en: measure word for lamps and lanterns
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎn. Counts lamps and lanterns (一盏台灯 'a desk lamp', 一盏灯笼 'a lantern').

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

examples.text: 门口挂着两盏红灯笼。
examples.trans: Two red lanterns hang by the entrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个盒子 ('a small box').

examples.text: 搬家公司清空梧桐巷之前，我从阁楼架子救下了这个盒子。
examples.trans: Before the movers cleared Wutong Lane, I saved this box from the attic shelf.

examples.text: 这个小木头盒子装的是老照片。
examples.trans: This little wooden box holds old photographs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gài. Used for stamping an official seal (盖印章) or putting on a lid.

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 文件下面已经盖好了红色印章。
examples.trans: The red official seal has already been stamped at the bottom of the document.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 目前阶段 ('the current stage').

examples.text: 完全正确！目前你们四张桌子只接待住店客人。
examples.trans: Exactly right! Right now your four tables only serve overnight inn guests.

examples.text: 目前八间客房周末都已经订满了。
examples.trans: At present, all eight guest rooms are booked for the weekend.

meanings.en: stare at; keep eyes fixed on
meanings.note: Pinyin: dīng. Usually pairs with 着 (盯着 'staring closely at').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 他盯着墙上的地图看了很久。
examples.trans: He stared at the map on the wall for a long time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí. Describes straight lines or walking straight ahead (直走).

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí jiē. Describes doing something directly without detours.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng xìn. Used for trusting people or believing news.

examples.text: 真不敢相信您也住在这家客栈，宋老师。
examples.trans: I can hardly believe you are staying at this very same inn, Teacher Song.

examples.text: 我相信你们一定能把咖啡馆办好。
examples.trans: I believe you will definitely run a wonderful café.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shěng xīn. Praises reliable designs or helpful people.

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

examples.text: 把修理工具分类放好，找起来最省心。
examples.trans: Sorting repair tools neatly makes finding them trouble-free.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi tóu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 紧锁眉头 ('furrowed brows').

examples.text: 他说什么？你怎么皱眉头了？
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: take a look; have a quick look
meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn kan. Friendly reduplicated form of 看.

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kān guǎn. Note first tone kān when meaning 'watch over / guard'.

examples.text: 给你们添麻烦了，老陈。谢谢这一周帮我看管箱子。
examples.trans: Sorry for causing you trouble, Chen. Thank you for guarding the bag all week.

examples.text: 我们替他看管了一周蓝箱子，他一定愿意帮忙！
examples.trans: After we guarded his blue suitcase all week, he will gladly help!

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn huā. Pairs with 眼 in 看花眼 ('eyes playing tricks').

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

examples.text: 小字看久了，眼睛容易看花。
examples.trans: Read tiny print too long and your eyes start blurring.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn jiàn. Result compound: 看 ('look') + 见 ('perceive') = 'actually see'.

examples.text: 正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
examples.trans: Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn míng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个真名 ('a real name').

examples.text: 等等——星期三晚上你又用真名住进来了？
examples.trans: Wait—and Wednesday night you checked in here under your real name?

examples.text: 那是他的小名，很少有人知道他的真名。
examples.trans: That is his childhood nickname; few people know his formal name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn zhèng. Attributive adjective ('genuine').

examples.text: 哈哈！跟我到院子里来一分钟，给你们看我真正做什么！
examples.trans: Haha! Come out to the courtyard for a minute—let me show you what I really do!

examples.text: 遇到急事的时候，才看得出真正的朋友。
examples.trans: In an emergency, you see who your true friends are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn chéng. Praises heartfelt honesty.

examples.text: 这三年我很想你。真诚又清楚。第三句呢？
examples.trans: I missed you very much these three years. Honest and clear. And the third line?

examples.text: 她真诚的笑容让每位客人都觉得亲切。
examples.trans: Her genuine smile makes every guest feel welcome.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn. Counts quick looks after verbs of looking (看一眼, 扫一眼 'take a quick look').

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn shú. Literally 'eye-familiar'.

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 这位先生看着很眼熟，好像在哪儿见过。
examples.trans: This gentleman looks familiar, as if we met somewhere before.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jing. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双眼睛 ('a pair of eyes').

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

examples.text: 咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
examples.trans: One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! It tastes identical to Wutong Lane!

related.gloss: a pair of eyes (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zháo jí. Note second tone zháo here (别着急 'no rush / don't worry').

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 离发车还有一个小时，您不用着急。
examples.trans: There is still an hour until departure, so no need to rush.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuì. Everyday verb for sleeping (睡得好 'sleep well').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

meanings.en: hide the truth from; keep in the dark
meanings.note: Pinyin: mán. Used when keeping a secret from someone.

examples.text: 别瞒了，小晴，我们很专业！先生，我们敬重成都旅游指南！
examples.trans: No hiding it, Qing, let's be professional! Sir, we respect the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 我们都是好朋友，别瞒着我。
examples.trans: We are good friends—do not keep me in the dark.

知道.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.en: know (a fact or piece of information)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī dào. Contrast 认识 ('know a person or place').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duǎn huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句短话 ('a short note').

examples.text: 先说三句短话。第一句：你好，志鹏，谢谢你来。
examples.trans: Start with three short lines. First: Hello, Zhipeng, thank you for coming.

examples.text: 他在明信片背面留了一句温暖的短话。
examples.trans: He left a warm short note on the back of the postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵石墙 ('a stone wall').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 院子北边的老石墙上爬满了绿藤。
examples.trans: Green vines climb across the old stone wall on the north side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块石头 ('a stone').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条石板路 ('a flagstone lane').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 梧桐巷的青石板路已经走过了几代街坊。
examples.trans: Generations of neighbors have walked along Wutong Lane's flagstone path.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qiáo. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座石桥 ('a stone bridge').

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 过了前面那座小石桥就到梧桐巷了。
examples.trans: Cross that small stone bridge ahead and you reach Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎ. Follows numbers directly for shoe and clothing sizes (四十四码 'size 44').

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 这双棕色皮鞋是四十二码的。
examples.trans: This pair of brown leather shoes is size forty-two.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yán jiū. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 一位研究成都历史小院建筑的建筑师啊！
examples.trans: An architect who studies historic courtyard buildings in Chengdu!

examples.text: 他专门研究南方老城区的木结构建筑。
examples.trans: He specializes in studying timber architecture in historic southern quarters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵砖墙 ('a brick wall').

examples.text: 老砖墙保暖，房间到天亮都暖和，放心。
examples.trans: Old brick walls hold heat, so the rooms stay warm until daybreak—don't worry.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块砖头 ('a brick').

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

examples.text: 墙角整整齐齐码着二十块红砖头。
examples.trans: Twenty red bricks are stacked neatly in the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān fáng. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋砖房 ('a brick house').

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 这栋两层老砖房冬暖夏凉。
examples.trans: This two-story old brick house stays warm in winter and cool in summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pò. Describes torn paper, cracked cups, or worn-out items.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只碗 ('a bowl').

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng. Used for touching objects or running into someone (碰到 'bump into').

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

examples.text: 我在街口正好碰到了老邻居。
examples.trans: I happened to run into an old neighbor at the corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pèng tóu. Casual verb-object compound meaning 'meet in person'.

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 今天中午十二点我们在大堂碰头吧。
examples.trans: Let's meet up in the lobby at twelve noon today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ mào. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种礼貌 ('good manners').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 小伙子对每位长辈说话都很有礼貌。
examples.trans: The young man speaks politely to every elder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Opens warm wishes (祝您睡个好觉 'Wish you a good sleep').

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

examples.text: 祝你今天工作顺利！
examples.trans: Wishing you a smooth day at work today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén qí. Expresses delighted wonder.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

examples.text: 拧紧那个小阀门，响声真神奇地消失了！
examples.trans: Tighten that small valve and the clanking magically vanished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén mì. Describes a mystery guest or locked box.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn zhǐ. Formal verb on signs and notices.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 院子客房区晚上十点以后禁止大声喧哗。
examples.trans: Loud noise is prohibited in the guest-room courtyard after ten p.m.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí. Frames distance between two places or times: A 离 B 很近 ('A is close to B').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 客栈离火车站只有十分钟路。
examples.trans: The inn is only ten minutes away from the train station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sī rén. Opposite of 公共 ('public').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 这是客人的私人信件，请妥善保管。
examples.trans: This is a guest's private letter—please keep it safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǒng. Read zhǒng as a measure word for kinds/types (这种, 那种); read zhòng as the verb 'plant/grow'.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个科室 ('a department').

examples.text: 等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
examples.trans: Wait, Zhipeng—you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

examples.text: 请去二楼的合同科签字。
examples.trans: Please go to the contracts section on the second floor to sign.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo. Counts seconds directly without 个 (十秒 'ten seconds').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miǎo zhōng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 几秒钟 ('a few seconds').

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zū. Used both for renting a property from someone and leasing it out (租给).

examples.text: 那我们平时为什么不租给客人呢？
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it out to guests?

examples.text: 他们把一楼租给了花店老板。
examples.trans: They leased the ground floor to the flower-shop owner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zū yuē. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份租约 ('a lease').

examples.text: 那你们的客栈租约就受市里法律再保护十年！
examples.trans: Then your inn lease is protected by city law for another ten years!

examples.text: 星期一你打开了卡住的门；这一周你救了客房、水管、早餐和租约。
examples.trans: On Monday you opened our sticking door; this week you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn. Describes holding something steadily or playing music evenly.

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn dìng. Describes steady water temperature or reliable work.

examples.text: 热！小晴你听到没？稳定、现代、五星级热水！
examples.trans: Hot! Qing, did you hear that? Reliable, modern, five-star hot water!

examples.text: 修好热水器后，水温一直很稳定。
examples.trans: Since repairing the heater, the water temperature has stayed steady.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn zhòng. Warm compliment for a poised person or tone of voice.

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 别看她年轻，处理急事却非常稳重。
examples.trans: Though young, she handles emergencies with calm poise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng. Describes an unoccupied room or bare floor.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng qì. Measure word (量词): 口 (kǒu), e.g. 一口新鲜空气 ('a breath of fresh air').

examples.text: 啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
examples.trans: Oh! Old water pipes sometimes get a little air bubble at night.

examples.text: 打开窗户，让雨后新鲜的空气进来吧。
examples.trans: Open the window and let the fresh post-rain air in.

related.gloss: a breath of fresh air (measure word 口)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kōng dàng dàng. Vivid ABB-pattern adjective.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

examples.text: 客人们出门游玩后，中午的大堂空荡荡的。
examples.trans: After the guests head out sightseeing, the lobby is empty at midday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuān. Used for garments and footwear that the body steps or slips into.

examples.text: 我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: 宋老师，您穿着很合适。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, it fits you very well.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎi. Opposite of 宽 ('wide'); describes narrow alleys or stairs.

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗 ('a window').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
