examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 打开木窗就能看见院子里的老树。
examples.trans: Open the wooden window and you can see the old tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng wài. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 窗外风景 ('the view outside the window').

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

examples.text: 窗外的老梧桐树在风里轻轻摇晃。
examples.trans: Outside the window, the old plane tree sways gently in the breeze.

related.gloss: the view outside the window (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng lián. Measure word (量词): 幅, e.g. 一幅窗帘 ('a curtain').

examples.text: 说这话的人每隔三十秒就扒着窗帘偷看一次！
examples.trans: Says the man peeking through the window curtain every thirty seconds!

examples.text: 天亮了，她拉开蓝色的布窗帘。
examples.trans: At daybreak she drew open the blue fabric curtains.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng hu. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗户 ('a window').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 窗边座位 ('a window seat').

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 宋老师最喜欢坐在窗边喝热薄荷茶。
examples.trans: Teacher Song loves sitting by the window with hot mint tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì kè. Crisp adverb for immediate action.

examples.text: 你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
examples.trans: Both of you?! Put down your teacups—come inside with me this instant!

examples.text: 接到电话后，他立刻赶回客栈帮忙。
examples.trans: Right after getting the call, he hurried back to the inn to help.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn. As a verb, 'stand' (站在旁边); as a noun, 'station/stop' (火车站).

examples.text: 晚上九点？你站这儿，我们一起去开门。
examples.trans: Nine in the evening? Stay right here; let us go open the gate together.

examples.text: 听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
examples.trans: Loud and clear. Are you standing beside the little stone fountain?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàn tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个站台 ('a station platform').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 谁能想到，星期一早上志豪在二站台拿错了蓝箱子。
examples.trans: Who would have thought that on Monday morning Hao grabbed the wrong blue bag on Platform Two.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān zhuāng. Describes graceful bearing.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 照片里的年轻钢琴老师神态端庄。
examples.trans: In the photograph, the young piano teacher looks poised and graceful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支笔 ('a pen').

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 请借我一支笔签个名。
examples.trans: Please lend me a pen to sign my name.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bí tǐng. Literally 'brush-straight'—used for posture or crisp suits.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

examples.text: 为了见重要客人，经理穿了一身笔挺的西装。
examples.trans: To meet an important guest, the manager wore a crisply pressed suit.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ jì běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本笔记本 ('a notebook').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā ying. Means agreeing to a request or giving one's word.

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 既然答应了别人，就一定要准时做到。
examples.trans: Once you give someone your word, be sure to follow through on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān. Used for signing names, contracts, or delivery slips.

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 请在这份收据下面签上名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name at the bottom of this receipt.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān míng. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 请您在这张登记表右下角签名。
examples.trans: Please sign your name in the lower-right corner of this registration form.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān shōu. Used when signing for registered mail or packages.

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 前台刚帮四号房客人签收了一个包裹。
examples.trans: Reception just signed for a parcel on behalf of Room Four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎn dān. Everyday adjective for straightforward tasks.

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

examples.text: 这道炒蛋做法很简单，味道却极好。
examples.trans: This scrambled-egg recipe is simple, yet tastes wonderful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suàn. Means 'calculate' or 'count as'.

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 我算了一下，一共十五块钱。
examples.trans: I added it up—fifteen yuan in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guǎn. As a verb, 'be in charge of / mind'; in compounds, 'pipe/tube' (水管).

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 前台钥匙归她一个人管。
examples.trans: The front-desk keys are in her charge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个箱子 ('a suitcase / box').

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个篮子 ('a basket').

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 竹篮子里装着刚烤好的热面包卷。
examples.trans: Freshly baked warm bread rolls sit inside the bamboo basket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fěn shuā. Used for repainting exterior woodwork or walls.

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 春天天气干爽，最适合粉刷外墙。
examples.trans: Dry spring weather is ideal for painting exterior walls.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng cǎi. Praises a great performance, story, or reaction.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 昨晚音乐厅的钢琴二重奏太精彩了！
examples.trans: Last night's piano duet at the concert hall was brilliant!

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块糖 ('a piece of candy / sugar cube').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

related.gloss: a piece of candy / sugar cube (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng fěn. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层糖粉 ('a dusting of powdered sugar').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 趁蛋糕还温热，在上面筛一层白糖粉。
examples.trans: While the cake is still warm, dust white powdered sugar on top.

related.gloss: a dusting of powdered sugar (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Pinyin: táng shuāng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 一层糖霜 ('a layer of frosting').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

related.gloss: a layer of frosting (measure word 层)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zāo le. Spoken exclamation when realizing a mistake.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

examples.text: 糟了，我把雨伞忘在出租车上了！
examples.trans: Oh no, I left my umbrella in the taxi!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Read jì when tying shoelaces, ribbons, or luggage tags (系着一张纸牌).

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 出门以前先把鞋带系紧。
examples.trans: Tie your shoelaces tight before heading out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn zhāng. Describes stage fright or first-day nerves.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lèi. Describes physical fatigue after travel or work.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 坐了一上午火车，您一定累了吧？
examples.trans: After riding the train all morning, you must be tired.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种红色 ('a shade of red').

examples.text: 邮递员刚让我签收的，上面盖着红色房产印章。
examples.trans: The postman just had me sign for it; it carries a red property-office stamp.

examples.text: 大门口挂着两盏喜庆的红色灯笼。
examples.trans: Two festive red lanterns hang at the front gate.

related.gloss: a shade of red (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯红茶 ('a cup of black tea').

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

related.gloss: a cup of black tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuē. Used for arranging a meeting time or meal.

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 我约了老朋友明天中午喝茶。
examples.trans: I arranged to meet an old friend for tea tomorrow at noon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí. Counts steps of a staircase (十八级台阶 'eighteen steps') or star ratings.

examples.text: 安静极了！他坐在第三级台阶上，听每一个音符。
examples.trans: So quiet! He sat on the third step, listening to every single note.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ bāo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个纸包 ('a paper packet').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 难怪星期二您打电话请我们别打开白纸包！
examples.trans: No wonder you phoned on Tuesday asking us not to open the white parcel!

meanings.en: slip of paper; short written note
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ tiáo. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸条 ('a paper slip / note').

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

related.gloss: a paper slip / note (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ pái. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸牌 ('a paper card / tag').

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

related.gloss: a paper card / tag (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个纸箱 ('a cardboard box').

examples.text: 只有三个小纸箱！最多四个！
examples.trans: Only three small cardboard boxes! Four at most!

examples.text: 四个纸箱五分钟就能搬走。现在就上去看！
examples.trans: We can move four boxes in five minutes. Let's go up and look right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng guò. Describes walking past a landmark.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

meanings.en: as a result; as it turned out; outcome
meanings.note: Pinyin: jié guǒ. Introduces an unexpected outcome or final result.

examples.text: 星期五之前我想在附近找个安静地方，结果忘了箱子还在这儿！
examples.trans: Before Friday I wanted a quiet place nearby, and forgot my bag was still here!

examples.text: 以为今天会下雨，结果出了一整天太阳。
examples.trans: We thought it would rain today, and as it turned out the sun shone all day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué duì. Strong emphatic adverb.

examples.text: 而且大哥想装作镇定的时候，绝对不会早到。
examples.trans: Besides, when older brothers want to act calm, they never arrive early.

examples.text: 用咸黄油炒出来的鸡蛋绝对香！
examples.trans: Scrambled eggs made with salted butter are guaranteed to smell amazing!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì xù. Followed directly by another verb or used alone.

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 喝口热茶休息五分钟，我们再继续整理。
examples.trans: Take a five-minute tea break, and then we will carry on tidying.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ. Describes green leaves, doors, or green tea.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suō xiě. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个缩写 ('an initial / abbreviation').

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!

meanings.en: lack; be short of; be missing
meanings.note: Pinyin: quē. Describes what is still missing from a room or recipe (还缺什么 'what is still missing').

examples.text: 干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.

examples.text: 做柠檬蛋糕还缺两个鸡蛋。
examples.trans: We are still two eggs short for making the lemon cake.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yáng máo. Measure word (量词): 团, e.g. 一团羊毛 ('a ball of wool').

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这条灰色围巾是用纯羊毛织成的。
examples.trans: This gray scarf is knitted from pure wool.

related.gloss: a ball of wool (measure word 团)

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi miào. Praises music, mornings, or delightful moments.

examples.text: 我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
examples.trans: Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!

examples.text: 清晨院子里的鸟叫声真是美妙。
examples.trans: Morning birdsong in the courtyard is truly lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fān. Used for flipping open a notebook (翻开) or doubling an amount (翻一倍).

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo rén. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老人 ('an older person').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 巷子里的老人们早上爱聚在一起喝茶。
examples.trans: Seniors along the lane love gathering for morning tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老师 ('a teacher').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo dì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个老弟 ('a younger brother').

examples.text: 倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
examples.trans: Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条老街 ('an old street').

examples.text: 凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
examples.trans: Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!

examples.text: 傍晚亮灯以后，整条老街好看极了。
examples.trans: Once the lanterns come on at dusk, the historic street looks gorgeous.

meanings.en: from a long way off; far away
meanings.note: Pinyin: láo yuǎn. Colloquial intensifier 老 + 远 ('from way across the lane').

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 还没进巷子，老远就闻到了肉桂香。
examples.trans: Before even stepping into the lane, we smelled cinnamon from afar.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér. Connects contrasting or balanced descriptions.

examples.text: 而你们两个孩子把十二号最珍贵的部分留在这儿了。
examples.trans: And you two boys kept the most precious part of Number twelve right here.

examples.text: 院子不大，而处处都很干净。
examples.trans: The courtyard is not big, yet every corner is clean.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ér qiě. Adds a further supporting point.

examples.text: 而且他坐晚上八点的火车到——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives on the eight o'clock evening train—only forty minutes left!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáo. Everyday verb for friendly conversation (聊聊 'have a chat').

examples.text: 两位慢慢聊——整个院子都留给你们。
examples.trans: Take all the time you need—the whole courtyard is yours.

examples.text: 坐在树下跟朋友聊聊天真舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting under the tree chatting with friends is so pleasant.

meanings.en: have a chat; talk for a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: liáo liao. Relaxed reduplicated form of 聊.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 下午有空的话，来我办公室聊聊吧。
examples.trans: If you are free this afternoon, drop by my office for a chat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pìn yòng. Workplace verb for offering a formal position.

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

examples.text: 试用期一结束，客栈就正式聘用了她。
examples.trans: As soon as her trial period ended, the inn hired her permanently.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ròu guì. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn), e.g. 一根肉桂 ('a cinnamon stick').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
examples.trans: At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ròu guì juǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个肉桂卷 ('a cinnamon roll').

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dù zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个肚子 ('a stomach').

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

examples.text: 刚跑完步，喝杯温水肚子最舒服。
examples.trans: Right after a run, warm water feels best on your stomach.

meanings.note: Pinyin: féi zào. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块肥皂 ('a bar of soap').

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 洗手池旁边放着一块清香的白肥皂。
examples.trans: A bar of clean-scented white soap sits beside the washbasin.

related.gloss: a bar of soap (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān bǎng. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双肩膀 ('shoulders').

examples.text: 挺起肩膀，志豪先生。记住那三句简单的话——我去开门！
examples.trans: Shoulders back, Mr Zhihao. Remember those three simple lines—I will open the gate!

examples.text: 哥哥笑着拍了拍弟弟的肩膀。
examples.trans: Smiling, the older brother patted his younger brother's shoulder.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kěn dìng. Colloquial cousin of 一定 for confident predictions.

examples.text: 箱子的主人肯定很快会来找的。
examples.trans: The suitcase's owner will surely come looking for it soon.

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dán xiǎo. Literally 'gallbladder small'.

examples.text: 那是星期一胆小的计划……那时候还没认识你们。
examples.trans: That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

examples.text: 别看那只小猫胆小，跟熟人可亲了。
examples.trans: That kitten may be shy at first, yet warms right up to familiar faces.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi miàn. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn), e.g. 纸张背面 ('the back of a sheet').

examples.text: 等等——通知背面回形针还别着第二页折起来的纸……
examples.trans: Wait—clipped to the back of the notice is a folded second page...

examples.text: 收据背面写着五金店的联系电话。
examples.trans: The hardware store's phone number is written on the back of the receipt.

related.gloss: the back of a sheet (measure word 面)

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎo zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好脑子 ('a sharp mind').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 遇到突发急事，她的脑子反而更清醒。
examples.trans: In a sudden pinch, her mind grows even sharper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo bù shēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵脚步声 ('the sound of footsteps').

examples.text: 快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
examples.trans: Hurry—I just heard footsteps on the second-floor stairs!

examples.text: 木楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。
examples.trans: Light footsteps sounded on the wooden stairs.

related.gloss: the sound of footsteps (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuō. Opposite of 穿; often pairs with 掉 (脱掉 'take off').

examples.text: 坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
examples.trans: Sit down, Zhipeng, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.

examples.text: 进屋很暖和，把厚外套脱掉吧。
examples.trans: It is warm inside—take off your heavy coat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张脸 ('a face').

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

examples.text: 他用温水洗了一把脸。
examples.trans: He washed his face with warm water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种脸色 ('a facial expression').

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

examples.text: 睡了一觉起来，您的脸色好多了。
examples.trans: After a good sleep, you look much more refreshed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí qi. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种脾气 ('a temperament').

examples.text: 哈！你怕签了名字，倔脾气大哥就不出门了！
examples.trans: Aha! You feared that if you signed your name, stubborn big brother would stay home!

examples.text: 老木匠手艺好，脾气也特别温和。
examples.trans: The veteran carpenter has fine craft and a gentle temperament.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuǐ. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条腿 ('a leg').

examples.text: 啊……不好。我的椅子在哪儿？我腿发软。
examples.trans: Oh... oh no. Where is my chair? My legs feel weak.

examples.text: 走了一整天，我的两条腿都酸了。
examples.trans: After walking all day, both my legs are tired.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jiā. Warm home-turf word ('our very own').

examples.text: 我梦想中的咖啡馆——就在自家院子里！等我去告诉市场老板们！
examples.trans: My dream café—right in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the market stall owners!

examples.text: 这些薄荷叶都是我们自家院子里种的。
examples.trans: These mint leaves were all grown right in our own courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū fu. Everyday praise for comfy chairs, warm water, or pleasant rooms.

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 换上干爽的毛衣，整个人都舒服了。
examples.trans: Slipping into a dry sweater feels wonderful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā tān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个花摊 ('a flower stall').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 街口花摊每天早上都有新鲜百合。
examples.trans: The corner flower stall has fresh lilies every morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huā cǎo. Measure word (量词): 盆, e.g. 一盆花草 ('a pot of plants').

examples.text: 总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
examples.trans: Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

related.gloss: a pot of plants (measure word 盆)

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng guǒ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个苹果 ('an apple').

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá hú. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把茶壶 ('a teapot').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá bēi. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只茶杯 ('a teacup').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎo méi. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗草莓 ('a strawberry').

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

examples.text: 桌上的小玻璃瓶里装着自制草莓果酱。
examples.trans: Homemade strawberry jam fills the small glass jar on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào diàn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家药店 ('a pharmacy').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
examples.trans: Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种蓝色 ('a shade of blue').

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

related.gloss: a shade of blue (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū cài. Measure word (量词): 盘, e.g. 一盘蔬菜 ('a dish of vegetables').

examples.text: 他上楼之前把蔬菜汤喝得一干二净。
examples.trans: Before going upstairs, he drank every last drop of the vegetable soup.

examples.text: 早市刚买回来的绿叶蔬菜特别新鲜。
examples.trans: The leafy vegetables just bought at the morning market are super fresh.

related.gloss: a dish of vegetables (measure word 盘)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bò he chá. Measure word (量词): 壶, e.g. 一壶薄荷茶 ('a pot of mint tea').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 晚饭后喝一壶热薄荷茶最助眠了。
examples.trans: A pot of hot mint tea after dinner helps you sleep soundly.

related.gloss: a pot of mint tea (measure word 壶)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng mì. Measure word (量词): 勺, e.g. 一勺蜂蜜 ('a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

related.gloss: a spoonful of honey (measure word 勺)

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗螺丝 ('a screw').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó sī dāo. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把螺丝刀 ('a screwdriver').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 门把手松了，用十字螺丝刀拧两下就好。
examples.trans: The handle came loose—two turns with a screwdriver will tighten it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó wén. Measure word (量词): 圈 (quān), e.g. 一圈螺纹 ('a turn of threading').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 拧螺丝的时候要先对准里面的螺纹。
examples.trans: Line up the threads carefully before turning the screw.

related.gloss: a turn of threading (measure word 圈)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuè yā. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项血压 ('blood pressure').

examples.text: 小晴，你真是天生的店长！我的血压保住了！
examples.trans: Qing, you are a born innkeeper! My blood pressure is saved!

examples.text: 医生叮嘱他平时少着急，注意血压。
examples.trans: The doctor reminded him not to fret and to mind his blood pressure.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li pái. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张行李牌 ('a luggage tag').

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng li xiāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个行李箱 ('a suitcase').

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街 ('a street').

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shang. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 整条街上 ('along the street').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个街口 ('a street corner').

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 出了院门走到街口就能打到出租车。
examples.trans: Walk out the gate to the end of the lane and you can hail a cab.

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个街角 ('a street corner').

examples.text: 先别灰心坐下！继续往街角看。
examples.trans: Do not sit down discouraged yet! Keep looking toward the street corner.

examples.text: 街角那家绿色招牌的药店九点开门。
examples.trans: That green-signed pharmacy on the corner opens at nine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē biān. Measure word (量词): 排 (pái), e.g. 街边店铺 ('streetfront shops').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 街边摆着四张木桌，坐满了喝早茶的人。
examples.trans: Four wooden tables along the streetfront are filled with morning tea drinkers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē dào. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条街道 ('a street').

examples.text: 看我们这家旁边写着：院子宽度、街道声音、安静九分！
examples.trans: Look beside ours: Courtyard width, street noise, quiet score nine points!

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo gē. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位表哥 ('an older cousin').

examples.text: 完全是意外！到表哥家打开一看，里面是乐谱和红丝带。
examples.trans: Completely by accident! At my cousin's home I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

examples.text: 我表哥在火车站旁边的邮局上班。
examples.trans: My older cousin works at the post office beside the train station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biǎo qíng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副表情 ('a facial expression').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 看到那块大蛋糕，孩子们脸上全是开心的表情。
examples.trans: Seeing that big cake, the children's faces lit up with joy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn shān. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件衬衫 ('a shirt').

examples.text: 看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
examples.trans: Look up at the attic window: Hao has changed shirts three times already!

examples.text: 他今天穿了一件干净的白衬衫上班。
examples.trans: He wore a crisp white shirt to work today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个袋子 ('a bag').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 请用纸袋子把这四个热面包卷装起来。
examples.trans: Please pack these four warm bread rolls in a paper bag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi zi. Measure word (量词): 床 (chuáng), e.g. 一床被子 ('a quilt').

examples.text: 我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
examples.trans: I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.

examples.text: 阁楼床上铺着一床厚实暖和的棉被子。
examples.trans: A thick, cozy cotton quilt is spread on the attic bed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Describes cracked porcelain, wood, or pipes.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 旧茶杯边上裂了一道小口子。
examples.trans: A tiny crack appeared on the rim of the old teacup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qún zi. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条裙子 ('a skirt / dress').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 她穿了一条浅蓝色的长裙子去音乐厅。
examples.trans: She wore a light-blue dress to the concert hall.

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Everyday spoken 'if', often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 等等——要是每天早上打开院门，卖街坊咖啡和热面包……
examples.trans: Wait—if we open our courtyard gate every morning for neighbourhood coffee and warm bread...

examples.text: 周经理，要是你不正式聘用她，我就请她进我厨房！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, if you do not hire her permanently, I am hiring her into my kitchen!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn miàn. Separable verb-object compound (跟朋友见面 'meet a friend').

examples.text: 约他星期五中午在这儿见面吗？
examples.trans: Asking him to meet you here on Friday at noon?

examples.text: 好久不见，真高兴今天能在成都见面！
examples.trans: Long time no see—how wonderful to meet in person in Chengdu today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī dìng. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规定 ('a regulation').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 按照新规定，早晨八点起向邻居开放。
examples.trans: Under the new rule, we open to neighbors starting at eight a.m.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guī ju. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条规矩 ('a house rule').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 老茶馆有个好规矩：进门先送一杯热茶。
examples.trans: Old teahouses have a warm custom: a hot cup of tea right as you walk in.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好觉 ('a good sleep').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 祝您睡个好觉。早餐七点半在楼下。
examples.trans: Sleep well, sir. Breakfast is at seven thirty downstairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jué de. Introduces personal impressions or feelings.

examples.text: 周经理的意思是……希望每位客人都觉得有十分满意！
examples.trans: What Manager Zhou means is... we hope every guest feels ten-out-of-ten satisfied!

examples.text: 我觉得这间向阳的书房最安静。
examples.trans: I think this sunny study is the quietest room of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

examples.text: 信封右上角贴着一张邮票。
examples.trans: A stamp is stuck on the upper-right corner of the envelope.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子角上 ('on the suitcase corner').

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角上还刻着两个小时候的缩写！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials carved on the corner!

examples.text: 木桌角上贴着防撞的软布条。
examples.trans: Soft protective strips are taped onto the corners of the wooden table.

related.gloss: on the suitcase corner (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiě shì. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 听完她的耐心解释，客人笑着表示理解。
examples.trans: After her patient explanation, the guest smiled in understanding.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì huà. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个计划 ('a plan').

examples.text: 那是星期一胆小的计划……那时候还没认识你们。
examples.trans: That was Monday's timid plan... before I met all of you.

examples.text: 周末开院子咖啡馆的计划大家都赞成。
examples.trans: Everyone is in favor of the plan to open the courtyard café.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Specifically used for reserving rooms, tickets, or restaurant tables (订房间).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 是谁啊？又有人订周末的房间吗？
examples.trans: Who is it? Someone else booking a room for the weekend?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn. Core verb in 认识 ('know'), 认出来 ('recognize'), and 认输 ('admit defeat').

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 明信片上整齐的方格字，我两秒钟就认出来了。
examples.trans: That neat block handwriting on the postcard—I recognized it in two seconds.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn shi. Contrast 知道 ('know a fact').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rèn shū. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 事情还没到最后一步，我们绝不认输。
examples.trans: Until the very last step, we will never give up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used both for jotting down notes (记下) and holding in memory (记住).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì lù. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份记录 ('a written record').

examples.text: 这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
examples.trans: All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.

examples.text: 这本厚账本记录着客栈十年的故事。
examples.trans: This thick ledger records ten years of the inn's stories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì de. Describes recalling something from memory.

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 这么多年过去了，您还记得？
examples.trans: After all these years, you still remember that?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì yì. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段记忆 ('a memory').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 柠檬蛋糕的香味唤醒了童年的温暖记忆。
examples.trans: The scent of lemon cake awakened warm childhood memories.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎng. Used for telling a story or explaining rules (讲讲 'tell about').

examples.text: 宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
examples.trans: After Teacher Song told our Friday story this morning, Mei baked it specially.

examples.text: 爷爷最喜欢给孩子们讲老故事。
examples.trans: Grandfather loves telling old stories to the children.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎng jiang. Friendly reduplicated form of 讲.

examples.text: 宋老师，快多讲讲梧桐巷那两兄弟吧！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, tell me more about those two brothers on Wutong Lane!

examples.text: 快给我们讲讲你是怎么找到那个旧阀门的！
examples.trans: Tell us how you tracked down that vintage brass valve!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǔ. Appears with 不 in 不许 ('not allowed / no …ing').

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

examples.text: 当然好啊，志鹏，只要谁也不许提卖旧钢琴！
examples.trans: Gladly, Zhipeng, as long as nobody mentions selling old pianos!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shè jì. Works as both verb ('design') and noun ('a design').

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng shěn yuán. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位评审员 ('an inspector').

examples.text: 除非他是写成都旅游指南的神秘评审员！
examples.trans: Unless he is a secret inspector writing the Chengdu Travel Guide!

examples.text: 冰凉的洗澡水？！成都旅游指南评审员就住在三楼啊！
examples.trans: Ice-cold shower water?! The Chengdu Travel Guide inspector is staying on floor three!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Often reduplicated softly as 试试 ('give it a try').

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

examples.text: 这件羊毛开衫很暖和，您试试吧。
examples.trans: This wool cardigan is very warm—try it on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì yòng qī. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段试用期 ('a trial period').

examples.text: 还有，小晴，今天是星期五——你五天试用期的最后一天。
examples.trans: And now, Qing, today is Friday—the last day of your five-day trial period.

examples.text: 五天试用期里，她把前台管得井井有条。
examples.trans: During her five-day trial period, she kept reception running smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì shi. Warm, low-pressure invitation to try something.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这把备用钥匙能不能开，插进去试试就知道了。
examples.trans: Slip this spare key in and try it to see if it unlocks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng shí. Praises straightforward honesty.

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 做生意最重要的就是诚实守信。
examples.trans: In running a shop, honesty and trust matter most.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng kěn. Describes an earnest apology or tone.

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 他道歉的态度十分诚恳。
examples.trans: His apology was thoroughly sincere.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Measure word (量词): 句 (jù), e.g. 一句话 ('a sentence / remark').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
examples.trans: I fix water pipes and chairs. People have to fix their own words.

meanings.en: should; ought to; be someone's turn
meanings.note: Pinyin: gāi. Short everyday form of 应该 ('should').

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō huà. Separable verb-object compound ('speak words').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng kè. Separable verb-object compound (我请客 'my treat!').

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 今天发工资，晚上的热汤面我请客！
examples.trans: Today is payday—tonight's hot noodle soup is my treat!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng wèn. Polite question opener used everywhere in Mandarin.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú. Used for reading books, rules, or documents.

examples.text: 整份文件还没读完呢，周经理，别先认输。
examples.trans: We have not even finished reading the whole document, Manager Zhou—don't give up yet.

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.en: thank goodness!; thank heaven and earth!
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè tiān xiè dì. Relieved four-character exclamation.

examples.text: 谢天谢地！那明天早上客人洗澡呢？
examples.trans: Thank heavens! What about morning showers for the guests?

examples.text: 谢天谢地，赶在下大雨以前到家了！
examples.trans: Thank goodness we made it home before the downpour started!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guì xìng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 您的贵姓 ('your surname (polite)').

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

examples.text: 您好，请问先生贵姓？有预订吗？
examples.trans: Hello, sir, may I ask your surname? Do you have a reservation?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Opposite of 输; can serve as a result complement (跑赢 'outrun / win the race').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 弟弟今天下棋赢了哥哥一次。
examples.trans: The younger brother beat his older brother once at chess today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Used for rising or lifting upward (抱起 'pick up in arms').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 从那个星期天起我们再也没说话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that Sunday we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn rè. Classic table invitation: 趁热喝 / 趁热吃 ('enjoy it while hot!').

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 肉桂卷刚出炉，快趁热吃一个吧！
examples.trans: The cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven—eat one while it's hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chāo guò. Followed by a number, age, or limit.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 这棵大梧桐树的树龄已经超过八十年了。
examples.trans: This grand plane tree is already over eighty years old.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè lái yuè. Placed before an adjective or feeling verb (越来越好 'better and better').

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 立春以后，成都的天气越来越暖和了。
examples.trans: After the start of spring, Chengdu's weather grows warmer and warmer.

趟.gloss: measure word for trips and errands

meanings.en: measure word for trips and errands
meanings.note: Pinyin: tàng. Counts round trips or errands (跑一趟 'make a trip').

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

examples.text: 我下午得去一趟市政厅。
examples.trans: I need to make a trip to City Hall this afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pǎo. Everyday verb for running.

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 十分钟之内你能跑个来回吗？
examples.trans: Can you run there and back within ten minutes?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条路 ('a road').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 雨停了，石板路还有点滑。
examples.trans: The rain stopped, and the stone path is still a bit slippery.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个路口 ('an intersection').

examples.text: 给我袋子和现金！路口市场七点开门。
examples.trans: Give me a bag and cash! The corner market opens at seven.

examples.text: 过马路的时候请在路口等绿灯。
examples.trans: Please wait for the green light at the crossing before crossing.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù biān. Measure word (量词): 排 (pái), e.g. 路边小树 ('roadside trees').

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 路边新开了一家卖热豆浆的小早点铺。
examples.trans: A breakfast stall selling hot soy milk just opened by the roadside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiào. Describes jumping or a racing heartbeat (心跳得好快).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cǎi. Used for stepping onto stairs, puddles, or boxes.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

examples.text: 下楼请慢点，小心别踩空了。
examples.trans: Walk slowly downstairs and take care where you step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn shang. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 身上衣服 ('clothes on oneself').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 出门忘了带现金，好在身上还有交通卡。
examples.trans: I forgot cash heading out, though luckily I still had my transit card on me.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn hòu. Measure word (量词): 步 (bù), e.g. 身后一步 ('a step behind').

examples.text: 老陈，看身后木头钥匙板：一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八！
examples.trans: Chen, look at the wooden key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

examples.text: 关门的时候请看一眼身后有没有人。
examples.trans: When closing the gate, glance behind you to see if anyone is coming.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duǒ. Used for ducking out of rain or hiding away.

examples.text: 等等——您本来打算把箱子交给店员，自己躲在街对面看？！
examples.trans: Wait—you originally planned to leave the bag with the clerk and hide across the street watching?!

examples.text: 当然来了。为什么躲在神秘纸条后面？
examples.trans: Of course I came. Why hide behind a mystery note?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tǎng. Describes lying flat on a bed or sofa, or an item lying in a drawer.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 旧铜钥匙静静地躺在木盒里。
examples.trans: The old brass key lay quietly inside the wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆车 ('a vehicle').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 门口停着一辆蓝色的出租车。
examples.trans: A blue taxi is parked outside the gate.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

车上.gloss: on the train / in the car

meanings.en: on the train / in the car
meanings.note: Pinyin: chē shang. Measure word (量词): 节, e.g. 车上座位 ('a seat on the train').

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

examples.text: 早班火车上很安静，不少人都在看书。
examples.trans: It was quiet aboard the morning train, with many passengers reading.

related.gloss: a seat on the train (measure word 节)
be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē lún. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车轮 ('a wheel').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 行李箱底下的四个小车轮滑得很顺。
examples.trans: The four small wheels underneath the suitcase roll smoothly.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn. Read zhuàn for spinning wheels or quick wits (脑子转得快 'mind works fast').

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

examples.text: 风一吹，纸风车就飞快地转起来。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the paper pinwheel spins fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn ràng. Legal/property verb for transferring a lease or title.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

examples.text: 原房东决定不转让这栋老院子了。
examples.trans: The landlord decided not to transfer ownership of the old courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn shēn. Separable verb-object compound.

examples.text: 留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
examples.trans: I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.

examples.text: 他刚一转身，就看见弟弟站在门口。
examples.trans: Right as he turned around, he saw his brother standing in the doorway.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuàn lún. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个转轮 ('a caster wheel').

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

examples.text: 给行李箱的小转轮滴点油就不卡了。
examples.trans: A drop of oil keeps the suitcase caster wheel rolling smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuǎn dá. Polite verb for relaying a message.

examples.text: 一定转达！请慢用。
examples.trans: I certainly will! Please enjoy your meal.

examples.text: 等宋老师下楼，我一定把您的话转达给她。
examples.trans: As soon as Teacher Song comes downstairs, I will pass your message on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruǎn. Describes soft bread, cushions, or softened cardboard.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng. Opposite of 重 ('heavy'); also describes gentle footsteps or soft voices.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这个小皮箱很轻，我来拿吧。
examples.trans: This small suitcase is very light—let me carry it.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

轻拿轻放.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.en: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)
meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng ná qīng fàng. Classic four-character phrase on fragile parcels.

examples.text: 轻拿轻放啊，老陈——明天中午就是星期五了！
examples.trans: Handle it gently, Chen—tomorrow at noon is Friday!

examples.text: 纸箱外面写着四个大字：轻拿轻放。
examples.trans: Four large characters on the outside of the carton read: Handle with Care.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Counts cars, taxis, buses, and bicycles (一辆出租车 'a taxi').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 你们听一秒……街上一辆汽车的声音都听不到。
examples.trans: Listen for a second... you cannot hear a single car from the street.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān jiǎo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块边角 ('a corner piece').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò qù. Directional compound moving across toward another spot.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng. Used for greeting guests at the door.

examples.text: 志豪，中午十二点你真的留在院子里迎志鹏吗？
examples.trans: Zhihao, are you really staying in the courtyard at twelve noon to greet Zhipeng?

examples.text: 店主笑着出门迎客。
examples.trans: The innkeeper stepped out smiling to greet the guests.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yíng jiē. Used for stepping out to greet an arriving guest.

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yùn qi. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种好运气 ('good luck').

examples.text: 全靠运气——加上星期一早上火车上拿错的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Pure luck—plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: 刚出门雨就停了，今天运气真好！
examples.trans: The rain stopped the moment we stepped outside—what good luck today!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái hǎo. Relieved adverb ('thank goodness!') or mild 'not bad'.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经准备好了。
examples.trans: Thankfully the bread dough in the oven is already ready.

examples.text: 还好你跑得快，赶在关门前买到了阀门。
examples.trans: Good thing you ran fast and bought the valve before closing time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái shi. Joins choices in questions (茶还是咖啡？ 'tea or coffee?') or means 'still'.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè xiē. Plural of 这个, needing no extra measure word before the noun.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè lǐ. Standard location pronoun meaning 'here' (spoken variant 这儿).

examples.text: 这里就是梧桐巷十二号。
examples.trans: Right here is Number Twelve, Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 请在这里签上您的名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name right here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn lái. Friendly invitation 请进来 ('please come in').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn bù. Works as both verb and noun.

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 才上班五天，她的前台工作进步飞快。
examples.trans: After just five days on the job, her front-desk work has improved fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuǎn. Opposite of 近 ('near').

examples.text: 把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
examples.trans: Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.

examples.text: 药店不远，拐个弯就到了。
examples.trans: The pharmacy is not far—just turn the corner and you are there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chí dào. Used for arriving late to work, class, or an appointment.

examples.text: 快请坐，宋老师！千万别说我上课迟到了二十五年！
examples.trans: Please sit down, Teacher Song! Tell me I am not twenty-five years late for my lesson!

examples.text: 她每天提前十分钟到店，从来不迟到。
examples.trans: She arrives ten minutes early every day and is never late.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì. Used for stepping back, refunding money (退钱), or checking out of a room.

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 如果不合适，七天之内可以退钱。
examples.trans: If it does not fit, you can get a refund within seven days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuì hòu. Used when clearing space safely.

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 开烤箱门有热气，请往后退后一步。
examples.trans: Hot steam comes out when the oven opens—please step back.

meanings.en: deliver; give (as a gift/complimentary); see off
meanings.note: Pinyin: sòng. Covers delivering items, offering something free of charge, and walking guests to the gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì hé. Takes a person or purpose as object (适合弹琴 'suited for playing piano').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
examples.trans: We are glad our quiet courtyard suits your... work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xuǎn. Everyday verb for choosing options.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 您可以选靠窗或者靠院子的座位。
examples.trans: You may choose a seat by the window or facing the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu guò. Describes light or sound passing through an opening.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 早晨的阳光透过树叶照在白桌布上。
examples.trans: Morning sunshine filters through the leaves onto the white tablecloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu lù. Used for sharing confidential information.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

examples.text: 评审结果正式公布以前不能向外透露。
examples.trans: Results cannot be disclosed before the official announcement.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Used for passing tools, napkins, or cups directly from hand to hand (递给我).

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 他双手把热茶递给客人。
examples.trans: He handed the hot tea to the guest with both hands.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tōng zhī. Measure word (量词): 份 (fèn), e.g. 一份通知 ('an official notice').

examples.text: 多半是粉刷街边木窗那种无聊通知吧。
examples.trans: Probably some boring notice about painting the street shutters.

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: sù dù. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种速度 ('a speed').

examples.text: 速度真快！店主给你收据了吗？
examples.trans: Impressive speed! Did the shopkeeper give you a receipt?

examples.text: 两个人一起摆桌子，速度比平时快一倍。
examples.trans: With two people setting tables together, it goes twice as fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Appears in split verb-object phrases like 道个歉 ('offer an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 临走的时候，他特意来道谢。
examples.trans: Before leaving, he came specially to say thank you.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个道理 ('a sound reason').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 老陈的话虽然简单，却非常有道理。
examples.trans: Chen's words may be simple, yet they make complete sense.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.en: take shelter briefly; duck out of
meanings.note: Pinyin: bì bi. Softened reduplication of 避 (避避雨 'shelter from the rain').

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

examples.text: 外面雨下大了，快进屋喝杯热茶避避雨吧。
examples.trans: The rain is coming down hard—step inside for hot tea until it passes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.
